# Baraka Events

> Baraka Events is an event planning and management company based in Gulberg III, Lahore, with 15+ years of experience. We plan weddings, corporate events and private celebrations across the city, with catering from our own kitchen and team.

## Key facts

- What we do: event planning and event management: weddings and every wedding function, corporate events and private celebrations.
- Experience: 15+ years of experience.
- Address: LG 13A, Big City Plaza, Liberty Roundabout, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/iXCcf5Ko2GKd6vjk7
- Phone and WhatsApp: +92 313 9999039 (WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923139999039)
- Email: Booking@barakaevents.com
- Office hours: Monday to Saturday, 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM
- Founder: Malik Bilal, Founder and CEO. Our founder personally manages each event, supported by our team.
- Catering: our own kitchen and catering team. 8 food menus from Rs. 2,200 to Rs. 6,700 per person.
- Social: https://instagram.com/Barakaeventsofficial
- Social: https://facebook.com/Barakaeventsofficial
- Social: https://youtube.com/@Barakaeventsofficial
